payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.
outcome.target: A frog is visibly placed within the toilet bowl.
outcome.reference: The toilet in the input image.

check.question: Is a frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl?
check.complete_when: A recognizable frog is visibly inside the toilet bowl.
check.partial_when: A frog is visible in or at the toilet, but is not clearly placed inside the bowl.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no frog has been added to or placed at the toilet.
check.unknown_when: The toilet or relevant area cannot be assessed, or the evidence is ambiguous.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The edited image shows a recognizable green frog inside the toilet bowl; additional frogs appear on the lid and floor."}

parsed.evidence: The edited image shows a recognizable green frog inside the toilet bowl; additional frogs appear on the lid and floor.
